title.zh: 黄仁勋：英伟达过去一年投资德国近10亿美元，看好当地科学、数学与创业生态
title.en: 黄仁勋：英伟达过去一年投资德国近10亿美元，看好当地科学、数学与创业生态

current_state.zh: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said the company invested nearly $1 billion in Germany over the past year and has become one of the country's larger venture investors, citing Germany's science, math, and startup ecosystem and noting that about half of newly founded companies there are AI-focused.
current_state.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said the company invested nearly $1 billion in Germany over the past year and has become one of the country's larger venture investors, citing Germany's science, math, and startup ecosystem and noting that about half of newly founded companies there are AI-focused.
